title: Let the conversation hold the stage.
intro: A character needs a world and a personality, but every visible element competes with the conversation. I refined the dark interface to separate navigation, dialogue and character context, while keeping them connected.

items.label: BEFORE

figure.alt: Previous Talkie chat screen with a textured background, gold character card and top navigation

items.title: Strong artwork, a busy surrounding frame.
body: The illustrated background, large character card and site header share attention with the message thread.

items.label: REDESIGN

figure.alt: Redesigned Talkie chat with quieter background, message column and character information panel

items.title: A clearer center for the exchange.
body: A quieter backdrop supports the messages. Character information and cards sit in their own panel, while recent chats stay in the shared navigation.

blocks.label: THE BALANCE
blocks.text: Keep the character present without making every part of the interface compete for attention.

body: The interaction notes define collapsible supporting panels and a compact character identity when content scrolls. These details preserve access to context while allowing the conversation to occupy more of the experience.
